Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headache
consistent with whiplash-type cervical injury. The mechanism of the collsiion and the force involved are well matched to the
injury reported. Over the course of care the patient attended 28 visits, a somewhat longer course than is typical for this
presentation, with treatment directed at restoring cervical range of motion, reducing muscle guarding, and managing pain through
manual therapy, graded exercise, and home program instruction. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the
injury. No prior injury to the cervical spine or surrounding soft tissue is known to this office. Billing records reviewed for this
course of care show no duplicated or repeated charges for the same services. At last assessment the patient reported partial
improvement in symptoms with ongoing but diminishing limitations in neck mobility. Continued home exercise and periodic
reassessment are recommended, with return precautions reviewed.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
